units.source_text: 之后大家的话越来越少了，都只一个劲的动筷子吃饭罢了。

en.t: After that, everyone spoke less and less, and they simply kept moving their chopsticks and eating.

units.source_text: 但是母亲却突然像想起什么一样，不住地夸奖油灯的明亮，就连嘴唇上的肿疮都好像挂着微笑。

en.t: But Mother suddenly seemed to remember something and kept praising how bright the oil lamp was; even the sore on her lip seemed to be smiling.
